Thanks again for taking the time on Friday. As part of BrightCo's SOC 2 scoping we need a small evidence bundle focused on personnel credentialing and lifecycle controls. Can you confirm whether you can provide the following by EOD May 7?

- Training completion report (last 12 months) scoped to security awareness and secure coding (CSV or PDF)

- Recent deprovisioning log excerpt showing account removals (last 90 days) with change-owner notes

We prefer redacted artifacts and a Drive link with view-only access. If there's an internal playbook or runbook excerpt you can share that would be helpful, but not required.

Thanks — happy to extend the timeline by a few days if you need it.
